metadata.title: Execute-AzureRMVMRemoteScriptRunbook
metadata.description:
Lets you setup remote connection to all Azure ARM VMs in an Azure Subscription, for remotely executing 
PowerShell Scripts/Commnads on the target Azure VMs.

findings.title: Dynamic PowerShell code execution
findings.description: Dynamic evaluation can make a script harder to inspect and may enable downloaded or constructed code to run.

findings.title: Plain text is converted to a secure string
findings.description: File 'file-00001.ps1' uses ConvertTo-SecureString with plaintext. This will expose secure information. Encrypted standard strings should be used instead.

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Create-AzureAutomationCredentials' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$RemoteVMCredName' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$CredentialName' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$Password' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
